q1.explanationZh: 通知说 I have bottles of water for everyone（我给每个人都准备了瓶装水），所以学生不用自己带饮料。B 错：提到天气是为了提醒大家带外套；C 错：通知说不能带巧克力。

q2.explanationZh: 广告说这辆车 Good for riding in town or exploring the countryside（适合在城里骑，也适合去乡下探险），也就是能在不同的地方骑。A 错：车有新轮胎和新车灯；B 错：价格 £100 已经写在标题里了。

q3.explanationZh: available to download 说明简报已经可以在网上下载，includes everything students need to know about school 说明里面有学校的各种信息。B 错：简报已经发布，不用告诉学校自己想要；C 错：通知没有问大家想在简报里看到什么。

q4.explanationZh: 通知中的 take out books 就是借书（borrow），Friday is the last day you can do this 说明周五是最后一天可以借书。A 错：通知讲的是借书，不是还书；B 错：周五图书馆还开着，学生还能借书。

q5.explanationZh: Peter 说 you can upload it instead（你可以改为上传作业），也就是把作业发到网上。A 错：短信没有让 Danny 把作业交给 Peter；C 错：Peter 说不用担心把作业带到班上（don’t worry about bringing your history project to class）。

q6.explanationZh: 爸爸说奶奶放学后接 Priti 去她家吃晚饭，I’ll be there soon after that（之后我很快就到），他是在告诉 Priti 什么时候能见到她。B 错：Priti 在奶奶家吃晚饭，爸爸晚饭后才到；C 错：奶奶已经知道要去接她，不用 Priti 联系。

q7.explanationZh: Agadir 的介绍说初学者要在秋天去（Beginners need to go in autumn），那时海上安全、水也暖，所以只在一年中的某个时间适合初学者。A 错：Nosara 全年水温都暖和；C 错：Inch Marlow 只说很适合初学者，没有说季节限制。

evidence.quote: Beginners need to go in autumn when the sea is safe and the water is nice and warm.

q8.explanationZh: Inch Marlow 有著名冲浪运动员 Zed Layson 开的冲浪学校（a famous surfer, has a school there），可以跟有名的老师学。A 错：Nosara 的老师很优秀，但没说他们有名；B 错：Agadir 的介绍根本没有提到老师。

evidence.quote: Zed Layson, a famous surfer, has a school there at Surfer’s Point

q9.explanationZh: Nosara 还有有名的野生动物园，可以看奇妙的海洋动物，这是冲浪以外可以做的事。B 错：Agadir 只说了冲浪营；C 错：摄影师是给冲浪的人拍照的，不是另外的活动。

evidence.quote: The town’s also famous for its wildlife park, where you can see some amazing sea animals.

q10.explanationZh: Inch Marlow 的介绍说 In summer it rains a lot（夏天雨很多），也就是一年中有段时间天气潮湿。A、B 错：另外两段都没有说到下雨或潮湿的天气。

evidence.quote: In summer it rains a lot

q11.explanationZh: Agadir 有很多冲浪营，这些营地舒适友好，而且花费不多（don’t cost much），所以住宿便宜。A 错：Nosara 说的是冲浪老师收费不高，不是住宿；C 错：Inch Marlow 没有提到价格。

evidence.quote: These are comfortable and friendly and don’t cost much.

q12.explanationZh: 很多人都没听说过巴巴多斯岛南边非常适合冲浪初学者（A surprising number of people haven’t heard…），说明这里作为学冲浪的地方不出名。A 错：Nosara 只说海滩很安静，没说不出名；B 错：Agadir 很受冲浪者欢迎，一定很出名。

evidence.quote: A surprising number of people haven’t heard that the southern side of the island of Barbados is excellent for beginner surfers.

q13.explanationZh: 从 Nosara 镇中心可以轻松走到几个好海滩（you can easily walk to several good beaches），即步行就能到。B 错：从 Agadir 要开车（drive）不到 20 分钟；C 错：Inch Marlow 没说怎么去海滩。

evidence.quote: From the centre of the town of Nosara, you can easily walk to several good beaches for beginner surfers.

q14.explanationZh: 妈妈十几岁时去过纳米比亚，而且一直打算有一天再回去（she always planned to go back one day），所以她想第二次去。B 错：表亲只是和她一起去旅行，没说是那里人；C 错：上网查纳米比亚在哪里的是 Emma，不是妈妈。

evidence.quote: she always planned to go back one day

q15.explanationZh: 营地一般只有淋浴，但这个营地竟然有真正的浴缸（a real bath），Emma 说 I couldn’t believe it（我都不敢相信），所以让她吃惊的是洗澡的地方。A、C 错：她提到了厨房和游泳池，但没有因此感到吃惊。

evidence.quote: this one had a real bath – I couldn’t believe it

q16.explanationZh: Emma 每晚躺着听动物的声音，说这是假期里最棒的事之一，说明她很喜欢听。A 错：她没说床不舒服；C 错：动物太吵，她并不总能睡好（it wasn’t always easy to sleep）。

evidence.quote: However, hearing them was one of the best things about the holiday.

q17.explanationZh: 狮子睡在长草里，Emma 用了 Unfortunately（遗憾的是），说她没能拍到好照片，因为狮子很难看清。A 错：她说狮子看起来不吓人（didn’t look scary）；B 错：她不是没带相机，而是拍不清楚。

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, they were sleeping in long grass by a tree, and I couldn’t get any good photos of them.

q18.explanationZh: Emma 说她很喜欢露营，打算以后在自己的国家和朋友们一起去露营，与 A 意思一致。B 错：她没说露营很辛苦，营地还有厨师做饭；C 错：她没有提到天气冷热。

evidence.quote: I think I’ll try it in my own country with some friends

q19.explanationZh: make sure you don’t miss … 意为“一定不要错过……”，miss 表示错过。leave 是“离开”，lose 是“丢失”，放在这里意思不通。

evidence.quote: the Nimrah Bakery in the middle of the city

q20.explanationZh: 这里是被动语态：饼干在店里烤好，热乎乎地卖给（are sold … to）顾客。付钱（paid）和买（bought）的都是顾客，不是饼干。

evidence.quote: hot to customers

q21.explanationZh: 和后面的 or take them home to enjoy later（或带回家以后再吃）对比，可知是“马上”吃，用 immediately。suddenly 是“突然”，actually 是“实际上”，都不合句意。

evidence.quote: or take them home to enjoy later

q22.explanationZh: belong to 表示“属于”，这家面包店属于 Aslam。keep 不能表示拥有一家店，lend 是“借出”，意思都不对。

evidence.quote: to Aslam, who says that he sells 4,000 biscuits every day

q23.explanationZh: wait to do sth 表示“等着做某事”，店外总有人排队等着买饼干。standing 和 thinking 后面都不能接表示目的的不定式 to buy。

evidence.quote: to buy biscuits outside his shop

q24.explanationZh: 这段讲的是 Aslam 的面包店，他高兴的是自己的生意（business）依然红火。career 指一个人一生的职业发展，occupation 指“职业”，都不合适。

evidence.quote: is still so popular and successful

q25.explanationZh: be going to 后面接动词原形；谈天气“将会很好”用 be：the weather is going to be really nice。

evidence.quote: weather is going to

q26.explanationZh: a few 是固定短语，意为“几个，一些”：I’ll make a few sandwiches。

evidence.quote: few sandwiches

q27.explanationZh: on my way 是固定短语，意为“在路上，顺路”：我可以顺路买些饮料。

evidence.quote: my way

q28.explanationZh: 给对方两样东西选择时用 or 连接：cola or orange juice；也可以用 prefer A to B（比起 B 更喜欢 A），所以 or 和 to 都对。

evidence.quote: Would you prefer cola

q29.explanationZh: 空格处的词同时指可乐和橙汁两样东西，要用复数代词：both of them / these / those。

evidence.quote: The shop near my house sells both of

q30.explanationZh: if 表示“如果”：Tom 要先找到足球，才能把它带来。

evidence.quote: I’ll bring my football

q31.sampleAnswer:
Dear Jack
My favorate film is called Bohemian Rhapsody. The film is about the history of one rock band called Queen. I like it because talks about Queen’s songs, formation and about his vocalist, Freddie Mercury. The movie is amazing!
Best regards
Mateo

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：说出最喜欢的电影；讲电影里发生了什么；说明为什么喜欢它
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response:
Dear Jack
My favorate film is called Bohemian Rhapsody. The film is about the history of one rock band called Queen. I like it because talks about Queen’s songs, formation and about his vocalist, Freddie Mercury. The movie is amazing!
Best regards
Mateo
anchors.noteZh: 三个问题都回答了，每个问题各用一句话回答，条理清楚；使用了多种衔接手段（The film, it, because）；相关词汇丰富（the history of, songs, formation, vocalist, movie）；虽有一些语法和拼写小错误（favorate, because talks about, his vocalist），但有效使用了多种语法结构（is called, is about, I like it, Queen’s）。内容5/条理性5/语言4。

anchors.response:
Hi, Jack!
My favourite film is „Bolshoy”. In this film girl wants to be a good dancer balley. In finally she will good dancer balley. In this film I like actors.
By, her friend Anya
anchors.noteZh: 回答了 Jack 的问题，但只说了喜欢电影的什么地方，没有说为什么喜欢；用简单的衔接词（this, she）组织内容；用词较基础（dancer, actors），使用了简单语法结构（wants to be, I like）；有一些拼写和语法错误（balley, In this film girl wants, she will good dancer），但意思大体清楚。内容4/条理性3/语言2。

q31.explanationZh: 满分邮件要回答 Jack 的三个问题：最喜欢哪部电影、电影讲了什么故事、为什么喜欢它，并用连接词把句子连贯地连起来。

q32.sampleAnswer: It’s Mike’s birthday, and he is really happy, first, mum baked a chocolate cake for him, and then, his brother Mike, gave him a ball as a gift. Then, Mike and his brother went to the park, and played soccer there for two hours. It was a great birthday.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：一家人围坐在桌旁为男孩过生日；哥哥（弟弟）送给他一个足球作为礼物；两个男孩去踢足球，男孩射门进球
条理性：衔接连贯，使用连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的准确性与丰富性

anchors.response: It’s Mike’s birthday, and he is really happy, first, mum baked a chocolate cake for him, and then, his brother Mike, gave him a ball as a gift. Then, Mike and his brother went to the park, and played soccer there for two hours. It was a great birthday.
anchors.noteZh: 涵盖了全部三幅图的内容，信息传达充分；条理清晰，使用了多种衔接手段（and, first, then, him, there）；用词恰当丰富（baked, chocolate cake, gift, park, soccer）；语法结构准确（he is really happy, gave him a ball, went to, played soccer there for two hours）；有些地方逗号用得过多，但不影响理解。内容5/条理性5/语言5。

anchors.response: There is a Jack’s birthday. There are he, his brother, mum and dad. His brother is giving him a ball to football. Next day, Jack and his brother are playing football match. Jack score a goal.
anchors.noteZh: 涵盖了三幅图的要点，但细节很少；以基础方式衔接（his, and, him）；有一些相关词语（birthday, brother, mum and dad, ball, football, match, goal），准确使用了一些现在进行时（is giving, are playing）；错误较明显（There is a Jack’s birthday, There are he, to football, Jack score），但意思大体清楚。内容3/条理性3/语言3。

q32.explanationZh: 满分故事要写出三幅图的内容：一家人给男孩过生日、兄弟送他一个足球作礼物、两人去踢球并进球，并用 first、then 等连接词把情节串起来。
